options.name: Tegernsee Lakeside Village
options.upside: Beautiful lakeside views with easy hiking and good local food options
options.tradeoff: Popular spot can be crowded on weekends, reducing tranquility
options.concern: Some group members may find the hiking too easy or too short

options.name: Andechs Monastery and Brewery
options.upside: Cultural experience with historic monastery and renowned beer tasting
options.tradeoff: Less variety in activities beyond brewery and monastery visit
options.concern: Not ideal for those uninterested in religious sites or beer

options.name: Ammersee Boat Rental and Village Walk

options.concern: Weather dependent; rain would limit boating enjoyment

options.name: Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial Site
options.upside: Educational visit with deep historical significance and guided tours
options.tradeoff: Emotionally intense experience, less recreational or relaxing
options.concern: Might not suit group members looking for lighthearted activities
